sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Interlochen State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): Duck Lake modern campground 20/30-amp sites $34 (268 sites), 50-amp sites $39 (123); Green Lake rustic campground $20 (53 sites, no electric, equipment to 30 ft). The DNR's 2026 table: modern $32 (20/30 A) / $37 (50 A), semi-modern $27 (North Campground, outside the shower building's season), rustic $20; the booking site charged $32 / $37 on 2026-10-27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($34 / $39 modern and $20 rustic on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21; $32 / $37 / $20 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Interlochen North and South Campgrounds $37 / $32 modern, $27 semi-modern; Green Lake Rustic $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen (Duck Lake Modern Campground amenities 'Electrical service', 'Some campsites with 50-amp service'; Green Lake Rustic: 'There's no electrical service') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (123 sites 20/30/50 A, 268 sites 20/30 A, all 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 53 rustic 'Electrical Service=Not Available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Duck Lake modern campground: 392 sites in north and south loops, generous and shaded by oaks, maples and virgin pine, many within view of Duck Lake; a short path from the north loop to Interlochen Center for the Arts; equipment to 50 ft. Green Lake rustic campground: 52 sites in the 600 and 700 loops, no electric, equipment to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen ('Number of sites: 392' modern, 'Number of sites: 52' rustic; amenities 'Pull-through sites available') + midnrreservations.com allowed equipment (modern to 50 ft, Green Lake Rustic to 30 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Modern campground: toilet & shower building and sanitation station. Green Lake rustic: vault toilets and two hand pumps for potable water in each loop. Simple Adventures in the Duck Lake beach house sells food, camping supplies, firewood and ice.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen (modern amenities 'Concession or store', 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building'; rustic 'Vault toilet', 'Hand pumps for potable water is available at two hand pumps in each loop'; 'Simple Adventures ... sells food, camping supplies, firewood, ice'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen ('Interlochen Duck Lake Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'; 'Interlochen Green Lake Rustic Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: Duck Lake modern campground 392 sites (20/30 A, 50 A at 123, electric only, equipment to 50 ft, pull-throughs, shower building, sanitation station) and Green Lake rustic 52 sites (no electric, vault toilets, hand pumps, to 30 ft); both reservable online or by phone. Fees 20-37 (2026 DNR table) -> 20-39 (2027 booking site; rustic $20 is the low; 2026 in the note), Recreation Passport in fees.note. Season (North Apr 22 - Oct 31, South May 15 - Sep 30) already manual. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing operator website and phone: the entry links only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/) and has no phone. The park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/interlochen; park phone 231-276-9511 (reservations 800-447-2757).
